name: mashumaro-canonical-wire-representations
instr:
mashumaro cannot produce canonical wire representations for reproducible artifacts, content addressing, and signatures across dict, JSON, ORJSON, YAML, TOML, and MessagePack. Add opt-in canonical codecs and mixin methods. Equivalent typed values must produce identical text or bytes, and canonical readers must reject alternate valid spellings.

Apply effective aliases, strategies, dialect composition, omissions, and hooks exactly once. Normalize nested mappings deterministically while preserving sequence order and scalar meaning. JSON uses stable UTF-8 text; YAML is one alias-free document; MessagePack preserves native binary data; TOML has stable tables; and ORJSON text encoded as UTF-8 equals its canonical bytes. Corresponding standalone codecs and mixins must emit and verify the same wire representation.

Reject noncanonical input before typed construction or post-deserialization hooks. Cycles, non-finite numbers, unsupported keys, and unrepresentable values raise path-aware `CanonicalizationError`, a `ValueError` with `path` (a tuple of mapping keys and sequence indices, such as `(0,)`) and `reason`. Alternate wires raise `NonCanonicalInputError`. Failures expose no partial output.

`JSONSchema` and `JSONSchemaDefinitions` support canonical JSON without changing functional or stateful builder ownership. Ordinary mixin and codec methods, custom drivers, hooks, plugins, and schema results remain unchanged.

Mixins expose `to_canonical_dict`, `to_canonical_json`, `to_canonica
